decisions.note: University of Alabama; aggregator-reported intl admit rate ~80% (CollegeVine/Yocket consensus). UA CDS Section B does not separately break out intl applied/admitted; institution reports admissions without distinguishing intl. Value matches overall admit rate range (~76-80%) which is the established proxy for non-restrictive state R1 with high intl yield.

Colorado State University; Shiksha reports 89% intl acceptance rate, consistent with overall ~88.6% admit rate (38,520 applied / 34,118 admitted, 2024). CSU does not publish separate intl admit rate in CDS; aggregator number aligns with broad open-admit state R1 pattern.

Seton Hall University; no separately reported intl admit rate in CDS or .edu sources. Falling back to overall admit rate (~73% for 2024-25; 2% intl on campus). Class of 2029 saw 28,000 applicants → 1,625 enrolled showing increased selectivity. DERIVED tier — institution does not publish intl-specific number.
decisions.reason: School does not separately publish international admit rate; CDS Section B uses unified totals. Engine will fall back to overall admit rate path.

University of North Dakota; UND does not publish separate intl admit rate. Falling back to overall ~77.09% admit rate (Fall 2023). ~863 intl students from 96+ countries. DERIVED tier — institution does not differentiate.

decisions.note: Bowling Green State University; aggregator-reported intl acceptance rate ~81%, equals overall acceptance rate. BGSU has 892 intl students (5.07%); does not publish CDS breakdown for intl. SCRAPED tier.

South Dakota State University; Upgrad-reported 75% intl admit rate. SDSU does not publish CDS breakdown for intl. Overall Fall 2023: 86% (~11,505 admits including 702 intl). SCRAPED tier — third-party tracker number.

California State University, Northridge; no separate intl admit rate published. Overall 92.4% admit (33,300 apps → 30,800 admits, Class of 2028); intl undergraduate enrollments 950-1,024 (Fall 2024). DERIVED, using overall admit as proxy minus slight adjustment for selectivity layer.

Idaho State University; ISU does not separately report intl admit rate. Overall 96.7% (2023: 7,712 applied / 7,460 admitted). Effectively open-admit; 367 intl enrolled (2.81%). DERIVED — overall as proxy.

decisions.note: Central Michigan University; official .edu page states intl undergraduate freshman acceptance rate was 52.8% Fall Semester 2023 (transfer 58.1%). Notably more selective than overall ~77% admit rate. OFFICIAL tier from institution's own international admissions page.

James Madison University; aggregator-reported 86.3% intl acceptance rate. Overall 71.5% (2024: 38,426 applied / 27,480 admitted); intl 1% of student body so fewer apply but high admit rate is plausible for VA state R2. SCRAPED tier.

University of North Carolina Wilmington; UNCW does not separately report intl admit rate. Overall ~64.24% (2024-25: 20,393 applied / 13,101 admitted). 322 intl out of 18,030 total. DERIVED — overall as proxy.

decisions.note: Macalester College; per .edu intl FAQ + ISP statistics, intl admit rate has ranged 6-11% in recent years (need-aware admissions for intl). International students were 23% of admitted Class of 2028. Using midpoint 9%. Overall admit 28.5% (8,968 → 2,558 in 2024) — intl substantially more selective as expected for elite LAC.

Reed College; intl acceptance rate 4.51% for 2024 application year (190 admits from 4,213 intl applicants), down from 5.64% (2023: 218/3,867). Numbers reported via Reed Institutional Research CDS Section C. OFFICIAL tier — elite LAC with restrictive aid for intl.

University of Minnesota Twin Cities; Shiksha reports ~82% intl admit (Fall 2024: ~1,300 intl applied, ~1,000+ admitted). Overall 79.7% Class of 2028. CDS shows 1,975 intl among 31,855 undergrads. Plausible — slightly above overall, consistent with desirable intl pipeline. SCRAPED.

Pacific Lutheran University; PLU does not separately report intl admit rate. Overall 78% admit. ~4% intl from 21 countries. DERIVED — overall used as proxy for small LAC with welcoming intl admissions.
decisions.reason: School does not separately publish international admit rate; CDS Section B uses unified totals. Engine will fall back to overall admit rate path.

decisions.note: Wheaton College Massachusetts; no separate intl admit rate published. Overall 67.73% (5,835 applied / 3,952 admitted, 2024-25). ~7% intl student body. DERIVED — institution does not differentiate.

Whitman College; intl acceptance rate 7.6% for 2024 (vs 63.8% domestic). Elite LAC, need-aware for intl. Aggregator references Whitman CDS. SCRAPED tier — number is plausible and matches need-aware LAC pattern (cf. Reed 4.51%, Macalester ~9%).

decisions.reason: Augustana University (Sioux Falls, SD) does not publish separate intl admit rate in CDS; aggregator searches returned only enrollment percentages (~8% intl from 40 countries, ~70 new intl in recent class) but no applied/admitted breakdown for international applicants. Small institution with rolling admissions; no third-party tracker reports an intl-specific rate.

decisions.note: Pitzer College; no separately published intl admit rate. Overall acceptance rate 17-25% across recent cycles; intl students ~10% of undergrads (105/1,242 in 2025). As an elite LAC and Claremont Consortium need-aware for intl, intl admit rate typically slightly below overall. Estimating ~13% as conservative midpoint. DERIVED.

Baruch College (CUNY); one aggregator notes intl 'face tougher odds around 40%' vs overall ~47.52%. Baruch has 1,736 intl (8.64% — 1,031 UG / 705 grad). CUNY system requires strong TOEFL/IELTS. DERIVED — slight discount to overall, plausible for selective CUNY business school where intl pool is competitive.
